artworks.title: Palamedes
artworks.description: Canova's neoclassical Palamedes — the inventor-hero Odysseus framed, Trojan War's first judicial murder.

artworks.title: Odysseus Feigns Madness
artworks.description: Odysseus feigning madness — the draft-dodge Palamedes exposed, the insult that seeds the forged letter and the grave.

artworks.title: Palamedes (Promptuarii Iconum Insigniorum)
artworks.description: Rouillé's Promptuarii woodcut — Renaissance emblem of Palamedes, the wise Achaean undone by envy.

artworks.title: Reconstruction of the Nekyia of Polygnotus (with Palamedes among the dead)
artworks.artist: Carl Robert and Hermann Schenck (after Polygnotus)
artworks.description: Polygnotus Nekyia reconstruction — Palamedes among the dead, the framed inventor still present in the underworld catalogue.

popCulture.title: Palamedes
popCulture.description: The inventor framed by Odysseus' forged letter — the Trojan War's first judicial murder, and the seed of Nauplius' revenge.
